lessons: Gate failure is caused by the implementer's own new file. tests/integration/test_git_fake_adoption.py flags tests/unit/test_mcp_tools.py because it builds its own Git stand-in. Its PATTERN matches `git = SimpleNamespace(`, NS, Mock, MagicMock or AsyncMock, a `class FakeGit`/`Git`, `spec=Git`, and

In tests/unit/test_mcp_tools.py, replace every hand-built Git stand-in with `from tests.git_fake import GitFake`. Pass per-method overrides, such as `GitFake(_run=...)` for the stats checks.json `git show`, or a callable or exception for other methods. Also rename any `fake_git` identifier.

Before committing, run `./dev.py test tests/integration/test_git_fake_adoption.py` and the ticket's `## Verification` command. Both must exit 0. Keep test_mcp_tools.py coverage of the mcp.py, stats.py and context.py lines unchanged.
